9a39571c0786.t: Yosuke: seorang lelaki botak dalam pakaian merah jambu memegang alat panjang bercabang dua, ditunjukkan dibesarkan dalam belon percakapan.

9ac8eb2694d6.en: Morika in Arcs 2 to 4: a blond young man shown shirtless in dark trousers and in full silver-and-gold armor with a sword.
9ac8eb2694d6.t: Morika dalam Arka 2 hingga 4: seorang lelaki muda berambut perang ditunjukkan tidak berbaju dengan seluar gelap dan dalam perisai perak dan emas lengkap dengan pedang.

9b0934cf0198.en: Likes and dislikes: likes spirits and strong liquors, especially fruity ones, and refined cheeses, meats and the like. Hates fish, even the smell of it.
9b0934cf0198.t: Suka dan tidak suka: suka spirit dan arak keras, terutamanya yang berperisa buah, dan keju, daging dan seumpamanya yang halus. Benci ikan, malah baunya.

9b1337884f33.en: Flaws: makes everything about himself; grandiose; narcissistic, and lashes out if you mess with his looks; vain; superficial; moody; condemnatory; insecure; jealous.
9b1337884f33.t: Kelemahan: menjadikan segala-galanya tentang dirinya; suka membesar-besarkan diri; narsisistik, dan melenting kalau kau usik penampilannya; sombong; cetek; moody; suka menghukum; tidak yakin diri; cemburu.

9bf8142446c0.en: Born in Sanbi on 1017 A.G. Asa 10th and raised there by parents with a Tier III profession: her mother, Coema, was the King-maid before her. She loved helping in the kitchen and decided to become a chef (1028 A.G.). At school, she took a few off-the-clock "cooking lessons" on how to warm up boys' sausages, and one of the boys was an accountant: she fell in love with accounting instead of the boy, and graduated in both (1036 A.G.). Coema knew she would grow into the role of King-maid and gave her a chance as a maid (1036 A.G.). Thanks to her outstanding knowledge, looks and playfulness, Coema promoted her to King-maid on 1038 A.G. Asa 9th, the day before her birthday. On 1038 A.G. Asa 77th, passing through Forway, she found Arukia and hired her at the drop of a hat.
9bf8142446c0.t: Lahir di Sanbi pada 10 Asa 1017 A.G. dan dibesarkan di sana oleh ibu bapa dengan pekerjaan Peringkat III: ibunya, Coema, ialah King-maid sebelumnya. Dia suka membantu di dapur dan memutuskan untuk menjadi cef (1028 A.G.). Di sekolah, dia mengambil beberapa “kelas masakan” luar waktu tentang cara memanaskan sosej budak lelaki, dan salah seorang budak itu seorang akauntan: dia jatuh cinta dengan perakaunan dan bukannya budak itu, dan lulus dalam kedua-duanya (1036 A.G.). Coema tahu dia akan membesar ke dalam peranan King-maid dan memberinya peluang sebagai pembantu rumah (1036 A.G.). Berkat pengetahuannya yang cemerlang, rupanya dan sifat suka bergurau, Coema menaikkannya menjadi King-maid pada 9 Asa 1038 A.G., sehari sebelum hari lahirnya. Pada 77 Asa 1038 A.G., semasa melalui Forway, dia menemui Arukia dan terus mengambilnya bekerja.

9c5c47389dd9.en: When she was a kid, her mother seemed to be a lazy, uncaring Darfaries, the woman her father, Lofinghy, had fallen in love with. They clashed more and more until things couldn't work anymore, and they separated. She took it to heart and set out to root out laziness in people, and she'll fight to make it happen, even if it pushes people away in the end. She cares about her people and her kingdom.
9c5c47389dd9.t: Semasa dia kecil, ibunya nampak seperti Darfaries yang malas dan tidak peduli, wanita yang dicintai ayahnya, Lofinghy. Mereka semakin kerap bertelagah sehingga tidak boleh diteruskan lagi, dan mereka berpisah. Dia mengambil hati tentangnya dan bertekad untuk membasmi kemalasan dalam diri orang, dan dia akan berjuang untuk mencapainya, walaupun akhirnya ia menolak orang menjauh. Dia mengambil berat tentang rakyatnya dan kerajaannya.

9e1b945a9bdf.en: Laramy (986 A.G. Paulin 34th) is a trader born north of Tolerideme in a village called Broken-tree. However, as soon as he was out of the uterus, he was in a wagon traveling around with his merchant parents. The merchant life led him to make friends across the four kingdoms, with some definitely using that friendship to make one-sided trades against him. He doesn't seem to pay much mind to it as he seems to enjoy that life more for the strong wanderlust he developed rather than purely for money. His wife and daughter also picked up the wanderlust, so you will never see them anywhere for more than a week, even at their physical address, which is just a bedroom at Melada's house—Laramy's cousin.
9e1b945a9bdf.t: Laramy (34 Paulin 986 A.G.) ialah pedagang yang dilahirkan di utara Tolerideme di sebuah kampung bernama Broken-tree. Namun, sebaik sahaja dia keluar dari rahim, dia sudah berada dalam gerabak mengembara bersama ibu bapanya yang saudagar. Kehidupan saudagar membawanya berkawan di serata empat kerajaan, dengan sesetengahnya pastinya menggunakan persahabatan itu untuk membuat perdagangan berat sebelah terhadapnya. Dia nampaknya tidak begitu kisah kerana dia nampak lebih menikmati kehidupan itu atas keinginan mengembara yang kuat yang dibentuknya berbanding semata-mata kerana wang. Isteri dan anak perempuannya juga mewarisi keinginan mengembara itu, jadi anda tidak akan melihat mereka di mana-mana lebih daripada seminggu, walaupun di alamat fizikal mereka, yang hanya sebuah bilik tidur di rumah Melada—sepupu Laramy.

9e47ddcc1e0d.en: Flaws: protective; judgmental, since he's idealistic to a fault; tense; demanding; punishing.
9e47ddcc1e0d.t: Kelemahan: terlalu melindungi; suka menghakimi, kerana dia terlampau idealistik; tegang; suka menuntut; suka menghukum.

9ea606f157ff.en: Takeo: a tall man in brown leather armor holding a large axe and a helmet, with a teacup charm.
9ea606f157ff.t: Takeo: seorang lelaki tinggi dalam perisai kulit perang memegang kapak besar dan topi keledar, dengan tangkal cawan teh.

9fc370f64823.en: Kianna (1004 A.G. Asa 14th) is a Toleridemian through and through, except when it comes to her apparent greed and exuberance that rivals the most high society from Forway. Her power grew vast once she became Jimmie’s first partner by giving birth to Ariana, a spitting image of herself, down to the ambition of being atop it all and the willingness to step on everyone and everything on her way to get there. Nobody is perfect, though, and it is commonly known that if you stroke her ego just right, you can make her gullible to pretty much any business deal, even shitty ones!
9fc370f64823.t: Kianna (14 Asa 1004 A.G.) ialah orang Tolerideme tulen, kecuali dalam hal ketamakan dan kemewahannya yang menyaingi golongan atasan Forway. Kuasanya berkembang luas sebaik sahaja dia menjadi pasangan pertama Jimmie dengan melahirkan Ariana, salinan sebiji dirinya, hingga kepada cita-cita untuk berada di puncak segala-galanya dan kesanggupan untuk memijak semua orang dan segala-galanya dalam perjalanan ke sana. Namun tiada siapa sempurna, dan umum mengetahui bahawa jika anda membelai egonya dengan betul, anda boleh membuatnya mudah tertipu dengan hampir apa-apa urus niaga, walaupun yang teruk!

a09a70d2bb54.en: Likes and dislikes: likes harmony. Really likes putting food on twinks' bodies and licking it off.
a09a70d2bb54.t: Suka dan tidak suka: suka keharmonian. Sangat suka meletakkan makanan di atas badan twink dan menjilatnya.

a234280f422b.en: Speech: a fatherly tone; clear-cut; a bold voice with a demanding, almost commanding tone. Clears his throat often, especially when he's annoyed.
a234280f422b.t: Pertuturan: nada kebapaan; jelas dan tegas; suara lantang dengan nada menuntut, hampir memerintah. Selalu berdehem, terutamanya apabila jengkel.

a25f5366573f.en: Laramy's family portrait for Arc 2: a gray-haired man (marked with an arrow), a pink-haired girl and an orange-haired woman.
a25f5366573f.t: Potret keluarga Laramy untuk Arka 2: seorang lelaki berambut kelabu (ditanda dengan anak panah), seorang gadis berambut merah jambu dan seorang wanita berambut oren.

a2e41da63241.t: Terpesona dengan: gadis Wozefaries yang kemas dan nampak bersih.

a331fe1295e1.en: Aurora: a curvy woman in a black-and-blue corset dress and boots, with a wide red hat.
a331fe1295e1.t: Aurora: seorang wanita berbadan menggiurkan dalam gaun korset hitam dan biru serta but, dengan topi merah lebar.

a346f87e1fb9.en: Flaws: dependent; insecure; claustrophobic; cowardly, especially around things he has never seen before, but he can be egged on to change his mind.
a346f87e1fb9.t: Kelemahan: bergantung pada orang; tidak yakin diri; klaustrofobia; penakut, terutamanya dengan benda yang tidak pernah dilihatnya, tetapi dia boleh dihasut untuk ubah fikiran.

a4a27728c00e.en: Hanako (1024 A.G. Asa 12th) was another victim of the Goodbye Cliff. She might not know who her dickhole parents are, but that doesn't matter anyways since she found herself in a better family—the Wood-People-Picker family. She might not officially be part of the guild yet, but that's neither here nor there! What matters is that the restaurant is now part of her soul! That's just paperwork collecting dust in a vault somewhere. What matters is that Mimi is at her side, sometimes annoying the living crap out of her, but she can't let that get in the way of caring for her only blood connection.
a4a27728c00e.t: Hanako (12 Asa 1024 A.G.) ialah satu lagi mangsa Goodbye Cliff. Dia mungkin tidak tahu siapa ibu bapanya yang tak guna itu, tetapi itu tidak penting pun kerana dia menemui keluarga yang lebih baik—keluarga Wood-People-Picker. Dia mungkin belum secara rasmi menjadi sebahagian daripada persatuan itu, tetapi itu bukan soalnya! Yang penting, restoran itu kini sebahagian daripada jiwanya! Itu hanya kertas kerja yang berhabuk di dalam bilik kebal entah di mana. Yang penting, Mimi ada di sisinya, kadang-kadang menjengkelkannya sampai naik gila, tetapi dia tidak boleh biarkan itu menghalangnya daripada menjaga satu-satunya pertalian darahnya.

a52cf1272db5.en: Attracted to: Darfaries and human men, as long as they know how to please a woman's wavering heart.
a52cf1272db5.t: Tertarik kepada: lelaki Darfaries dan manusia, asalkan mereka tahu cara memuaskan hati wanita yang berbolak-balik.

a77c888b717c.en: Attracted to: she's voracious. Born male, she keeps using nari gels to maintain her cute, feminine appearance.
a77c888b717c.t: Tertarik kepada: dia rakus. Lahir lelaki, dia terus menggunakan nari gel untuk mengekalkan penampilannya yang comel dan feminin.

a7ce3f681569.en: Anything spent on Arukia is split 50/50.
a7ce3f681569.t: Apa saja yang dibelanjakan untuk Arukia dibahagi 50/50.

a7f2111d86f1.en: Speech: doesn't know big words; slow to respond.
a7f2111d86f1.t: Pertuturan: tidak tahu perkataan besar; lambat membalas.

a807b4ef392e.en: Nailah (1004 A.G. Paulin 28th) is a village girl born to Sundeath parents that fled the desert weather. Not many people have seen or talked to her, but they have seen one of her beautifully intricate wood carvings on display somewhere. To be fair, many people assumed it was a pseudonym for another artist rather than someone living in a village called Rebula—why would such a brilliant artist live so far away from the big city? Her answer to that snob question always has been Rebula is where my heart is!
a807b4ef392e.t: Nailah (28 Paulin 1004 A.G.) ialah gadis kampung yang dilahirkan oleh ibu bapa Sundeath yang melarikan diri daripada cuaca padang pasir. Tidak ramai orang pernah melihat atau bercakap dengannya, tetapi mereka pernah melihat salah satu ukiran kayunya yang cantik dan halus dipamerkan di suatu tempat. Sejujurnya, ramai orang menyangka itu nama samaran artis lain dan bukannya seseorang yang tinggal di kampung bernama Rebula—kenapa artis yang begitu hebat tinggal begitu jauh dari bandar besar? Jawapannya kepada soalan sombong itu sentiasa Rebula ialah tempat hati saya berada!

a98a5a6d4af8.en: Speech: delicate, yet precise; she doesn't waste time. She brings people under her command through loyalty, built over years of service, slowly adding more for them to do. Somewhat like Neferteri, but she talks less, lets others hash things out and think for themselves, and is far less controlling and far more trusting. Hates being talked over: her expression chills even further, or she excuses herself and leaves.
a98a5a6d4af8.t: Pertuturan: lembut, namun tepat; dia tidak membuang masa. Dia membawa orang di bawah perintahnya melalui kesetiaan, dibina selama bertahun-tahun berkhidmat, perlahan-lahan menambah lebih banyak tugas untuk mereka. Agak seperti Neferteri, tetapi dia kurang bercakap, membiarkan orang lain berbincang dan berfikir sendiri, dan jauh kurang mengawal serta jauh lebih mempercayai. Benci dipotong cakap: riak wajahnya menjadi lebih dingin, atau dia meminta diri dan pergi.

a99ab4a21ab1.en: Takeo (969 A.G. Asa 23th) is Francisco's only son and a Darfaries to the passersby after they glance at his tall height and girthy protuberant teeth. Except! Takeo is technically human as he lacks the Darfaries' veins. He is known for being too reserved and polite with everyone, often going as far as dropping out of parties over any small conflicts rather than hashing them out. At the same time, he is a man of simple words... Maybe too few, as he's far more receptive to cutting your tongue off, or more likely your fingers with his favorite clipper, instead of telling you to shut up. Some think he has a weird power trip by purposely making his clipper as dull as possible, while others suspect he might be eating more Hifuna Yabucas than he should.
a99ab4a21ab1.t: Takeo (23 Asa 969 A.G.) ialah satu-satunya anak lelaki Francisco dan seorang Darfaries pada pandangan orang yang lalu-lalang selepas mereka menjeling ketinggiannya dan giginya yang tebal dan menonjol. Kecuali! Takeo secara teknikal manusia kerana dia tiada urat Darfaries. Dia terkenal kerana terlalu pendiam dan bersopan dengan semua orang, selalunya sampai menarik diri daripada pasukan kerana konflik kecil dan bukannya menyelesaikannya. Pada masa yang sama, dia lelaki yang kurang berkata-kata... Mungkin terlalu kurang, kerana dia lebih cenderung memotong lidah anda, atau lebih mungkin jari anda dengan pemotong kegemarannya, daripada menyuruh anda diam. Ada yang fikir dia ada rasa berkuasa yang pelik dengan sengaja membiarkan pemotongnya setumpul mungkin, manakala yang lain mengesyaki dia mungkin makan Hifuna Yabuca lebih daripada yang sepatutnya.

a9f881ac1b59.en: He grew up in the nearby villages with strict, hardworking parents, followed in their footsteps and became a woodcutter. He lives in Rebula with Nailah and their son, Vitor.
a9f881ac1b59.t: Dia membesar di kampung-kampung berdekatan dengan ibu bapa yang tegas dan rajin, mengikut jejak mereka dan menjadi penebang kayu. Dia tinggal di Rebula bersama Nailah dan anak lelaki mereka, Vitor.

a9ffa05df9cb.en: Strengths: firm; considerate; gentle; optimistic; punctual; obedient; loyal; to the point when talking business, and quite playful with her words with customers.
a9ffa05df9cb.t: Kekuatan: tegas; bertimbang rasa; lemah lembut; optimis; menepati masa; patuh; setia; terus ke pokok persoalan semasa berbincang perniagaan, dan agak suka bermain kata dengan pelanggan.

aa0a8ef39d9e.en: Attracted to: cute, dependable, handsome men taller than her, slender with some muscle.
aa0a8ef39d9e.t: Tertarik kepada: lelaki comel, boleh diharap dan kacak yang lebih tinggi daripadanya, langsing dengan sedikit otot.

aaa1cabf63d2.en: Intelligence: good street smarts, and a very capable adventurer. Her emotions can get out of control if someone pushes the wrong buttons, but at least she warns you before exploding. Her pet, Mugi, is extremely cuddly and rather smart: like a cat, but more cooperative, and it understands basic actions.
aaa1cabf63d2.t: Kecerdasan: sangat bijak di jalanan, dan pengembara yang sangat berkebolehan. Emosinya boleh hilang kawalan jika seseorang menekan butang yang salah, tetapi sekurang-kurangnya dia memberi amaran sebelum meletup. Haiwan peliharaannya, Mugi, sangat manja dan agak bijak: seperti kucing, tetapi lebih bekerjasama, dan ia faham tindakan asas.

ab82d4255e3f.en: Intelligence: a bookworm, but lacks street smarts, and he's not as sharp when it comes to verbal attacks: his sister wipes the floor with him in arguments, mainly because he's slow to respond.
ab82d4255e3f.t: Kecerdasan: ulat buku, tetapi kurang bijak di jalanan, dan dia tidak begitu tajam bila berdepan serangan lisan: kakaknya mengalahkannya teruk dalam pertengkaran, terutamanya kerana dia lambat membalas.

ac4923f8080a.en: Rimir (1012 A.G. Moacir 43th) is a Forway native with impressive skills in following directions as a station chef, even though he never had formal education. Other restaurants tried to steal him away from the head chef Yosuke, but he always refused. Many have asked him why a man with what seems to be a bright future is stuck working for a grumpy old man in a restaurant for the masses, though they never got a solid answer from Rimir. Gossip between chefs is that he had an unofficial contract, or maybe he was promised the restaurant when Yosuke soul-dies—but then again, why is he not the head chef already? Some do believe he must have had an affair with him.
ac4923f8080a.t: Rimir (43 Moacir 1012 A.G.) ialah anak jati Forway dengan kemahiran mengagumkan dalam mengikut arahan sebagai cef stesen, walaupun dia tidak pernah mendapat pendidikan formal. Restoran lain cuba merampasnya daripada ketua cef Yosuke, tetapi dia sentiasa menolak. Ramai bertanya kepadanya kenapa lelaki yang nampaknya mempunyai masa depan cerah terperuk bekerja untuk seorang lelaki tua yang pemarah di restoran untuk orang ramai, walaupun mereka tidak pernah mendapat jawapan yang kukuh daripada Rimir. Gosip dalam kalangan cef ialah dia ada kontrak tidak rasmi, atau mungkin dia dijanjikan restoran itu apabila Yosuke mengalami kematian jiwa—tetapi kalau begitu, kenapa dia belum menjadi ketua cef? Ada yang percaya dia pasti pernah ada hubungan sulit dengannya.

ac696efd144b.en: Likes and dislikes: likes fruits and vegetables in general; loves Domar baking and Sanbi fish; not as fond of meat. Likes pink, and feeling cozy and protected under blankets. Hates the cold, and people who pry into her life.
ac696efd144b.t: Suka dan tidak suka: suka buah-buahan dan sayur-sayuran secara umum; suka kuih Domar dan ikan Sanbi; tidak begitu gemar daging. Suka warna merah jambu, dan rasa selesa dan dilindungi di bawah selimut. Benci kesejukan, dan orang yang mengorek hidupnya.

ac956ef9eac8.en: Tarou (899 A.G. Asa 56th) is a Forfaries as he self-proclaims (as in Forway Darfaries.) He prefers Darfaries woman over any female human, but he can make exceptions. The same applies to all other facets of his life, and so he met, negotiated, mated, and ate with a whole bunch of individuals across the four kingdoms and surrounding regions. His daring adventures as a businessman gave him some lifelong memories and took him to places most people have never seen before, but one day it will cost him his life. Until then, he's carrying on, enjoying life as it happens, then traveling back to his home in Gandew to sip Rakuja wine.
ac956ef9eac8.t: Tarou (56 Asa 899 A.G.) ialah seorang Forfaries seperti yang diisytiharkannya sendiri (iaitu Darfaries Forway.) Dia lebih suka wanita Darfaries berbanding mana-mana wanita manusia, tetapi dia boleh membuat pengecualian. Perkara yang sama terpakai pada semua aspek lain hidupnya, maka dia bertemu, berunding, mengawan, dan makan bersama sekumpulan besar individu di serata empat kerajaan dan wilayah sekitarnya. Pengembaraannya yang berani sebagai ahli perniagaan memberinya kenangan seumur hidup dan membawanya ke tempat yang tidak pernah dilihat kebanyakan orang, tetapi suatu hari ia akan meragut nyawanya. Sehingga itu, dia terus menikmati hidup seadanya, kemudian pulang ke rumahnya di Gandew untuk menghirup wain Rakuja.

aced8f7c1c22.en: Strengths: playful; ecchi (unfazed by male genitals); friendly; flexible; personable; spontaneous; sympathetic; tidy; caring; trusting.
aced8f7c1c22.t: Kekuatan: suka bergurau; ecchi (tidak terkesan dengan kemaluan lelaki); mesra; fleksibel; peramah; spontan; bersimpati; kemas; penyayang; mudah percaya.

ae14be4a4904.en: Intelligence: average, with more knowledge of the Tea-Drinkers' business: he keeps the books and carries things around. He knows a good chunk of Forway like the palm of his hand.
ae14be4a4904.t: Kecerdasan: purata, dengan lebih banyak pengetahuan tentang perniagaan Tea-Drinkers: dia menyimpan kira dan mengangkut barang. Dia kenal sebahagian besar Forway seperti tapak tangannya sendiri.

ae1e9469429b.en: Hallucinations and vivid dreams when waking up or falling asleep.
ae1e9469429b.t: Halusinasi dan mimpi yang jelas semasa bangun atau hendak tidur.

ae21c08cf8a4.en: Habits: puts his hands behind his back; likes to smile faintly and stand still while talking to people, giving them one chance to say yes or no; picky and carefully observant in anything to do with the kitchen.
ae21c08cf8a4.t: Tabiat: meletakkan tangan di belakang; suka tersenyum nipis dan berdiri tegak semasa bercakap dengan orang, memberi mereka satu peluang untuk berkata ya atau tidak; cerewet dan teliti memerhati dalam apa saja yang berkaitan dengan dapur.

aed4f7d533a8.en: Tarou: a man with a tall purple ponytail in a fur-trimmed purple robe and a big belt buckle.
aed4f7d533a8.t: Tarou: seorang lelaki berambut ekor kuda ungu yang tinggi dalam jubah ungu berbirai bulu dan kepala tali pinggang yang besar.

af258dd58550.en: Strengths: funny; liberal; enthusiastic; curious; humorous; plucky and courageous; self-confident.
af258dd58550.t: Kekuatan: kelakar; liberal; bersemangat; ingin tahu; jenaka; berani dan cekal; yakin diri.

afa25203b3db.t: Suka dan tidak suka: cerut dan Steen.

afb445246d1f.en: Speech: short and sweet. She speaks her mind.
afb445246d1f.t: Pertuturan: ringkas dan padat. Dia cakap apa yang dia fikir.

afbf6232e8cf.en: Intelligence: what she lacks in intelligence, she makes up for in friendliness. She's like a monkey that gets its hand stuck in the cookie jar every single time, and keeps doing it anyway. Like a cat that talks.
afbf6232e8cf.t: Kecerdasan: apa yang dia kurang dalam kecerdasan, dia tampung dengan keramahan. Dia seperti monyet yang tangannya tersangkut dalam balang biskut setiap kali, dan terus melakukannya juga. Seperti kucing yang boleh bercakap.

afd96a4ca47d.en: Flaws: greedy; lustful; uncharitable; narcissistic; naughty; a killjoy; intrusive, sometimes far too intrusive; fixed on his objectives; superficial.
afd96a4ca47d.t: Kelemahan: tamak; bernafsu; tidak dermawan; narsisistik; nakal; perosak suasana; suka menceroboh, kadang-kadang terlalu menceroboh; terpaku pada objektifnya; cetek.

b105db6e7b84.en: Habits: avoids physical contact and keeps space between herself and others; looks coldly into people's eyes as she tries to hide her emotions; knows how to defend herself; cares about people.
b105db6e7b84.t: Tabiat: mengelak sentuhan fizikal dan menjaga jarak antara dirinya dan orang lain; memandang dingin ke mata orang sambil cuba menyembunyikan emosinya; tahu mempertahankan diri; mengambil berat tentang orang.

b14d1f588b02.en: Likes and dislikes: hates rich people, the Red Winga and lustful bastards. Likes abusing the nari gels she's given to escape reality.
b14d1f588b02.t: Suka dan tidak suka: benci orang kaya, Red Winga dan bangsat gatal. Suka menyalahgunakan nari gel yang diberikan kepadanya untuk lari daripada realiti.

b2e0901c7ef2.en: Flaws: intolerant; insensitive; tactless; temperamental; cruel; angry.
b2e0901c7ef2.t: Kelemahan: tidak bertoleransi; tidak sensitif; tidak berhemah; panas baran; kejam; pemarah.

b31630658041.en: Ukim (1023 A.G. Asa 39th) is the newest maid at Sanbi Castle, working the night shift and asking more questions than anyone thought possible. Friendly, curious and always humming, she wants to learn the job, the castle, and maybe a little of the drama too.
b31630658041.t: Ukim (39 Asa 1023 A.G.) ialah pembantu rumah terbaharu di Istana Sanbi, bekerja syif malam dan bertanya lebih banyak soalan daripada yang disangka mungkin oleh sesiapa. Peramah, ingin tahu dan sentiasa bersenandung, dia mahu mempelajari kerjanya, istana itu, dan mungkin sedikit dramanya juga.

b32cee2edaed.en: Luny (997 A.G Asa 64th) was a city girl born and raised in Forway's magnificent, ecstatic luxury, where anything is possible if you have the money. Despite all that, something deep inside her always longed for something different. Traveling about, rather aimless in life, a flame of passion arose within her when she visited Tolerideme. The simple, ironclad culture and life of Tolerideme folks drew her in like a wood people to a fost stone. With her deep, blunt opinions based on her vast knowledge, she became the courtroom scientist for Tolerideme, which led to her becoming a partner to Alford. Her jealous rants lead people to believe she would prefer the "wife" title, but such a notion doesn't exist in Tolerideme.
b32cee2edaed.t: Luny (64 Asa 997 A.G) ialah gadis bandar yang dilahirkan dan dibesarkan dalam kemewahan Forway yang megah dan menggembirakan, di mana apa sahaja mungkin jika anda ada wang. Walaupun begitu, sesuatu jauh di dalam dirinya sentiasa merindui sesuatu yang berbeza. Mengembara ke sana sini, agak tanpa hala tuju dalam hidup, api semangat timbul dalam dirinya apabila dia melawat Tolerideme. Budaya dan kehidupan orang Tolerideme yang ringkas dan teguh menariknya seperti wood people kepada fost stone. Dengan pendapatnya yang mendalam dan berterus terang berdasarkan ilmunya yang luas, dia menjadi saintis istana Tolerideme, yang membawanya menjadi pasangan Alford. Leteran cemburunya membuatkan orang percaya dia lebih suka gelaran "isteri", tetapi tanggapan sedemikian tidak wujud di Tolerideme.

b416414986b4.en: She provides information to the Red Winga. The better the information, the more of the Red Winga's investment in her it repays.
b416414986b4.t: Dia memberi maklumat kepada Red Winga. Semakin bagus maklumat, semakin banyak pelaburan Red Winga dalam dirinya yang dibayar balik.

b483e81eff71.en: Since Vol 1, she's no longer as subservient: she has more sass, pushes back, and would do it again to protect the people she cares about. Neferteri can still get her to comply with sweet talk and moves that look good for her maids (and Harry). As King-maid, she has no control over the general or the city guard. Sanbi gossips that she's becoming "Coema 2.0", which is kind of true, and Neferteri hates it. She knows every maid's name, and even how to spell it.
b483e81eff71.t: Sejak Jilid 1, dia tidak lagi sepatuh dulu: dia lebih lancang, melawan balik, dan akan melakukannya lagi untuk melindungi orang yang dia sayangi. Neferteri masih boleh membuatnya akur dengan kata-kata manis dan langkah yang nampak baik untuk pembantu-pembantu rumahnya (dan Harry). Sebagai King-maid, dia tiada kuasa ke atas jeneral atau pengawal bandar. Orang Sanbi bergosip bahawa dia menjadi “Coema 2.0”, yang memang agak betul, dan Neferteri benci akannya. Dia tahu nama setiap pembantu rumah, malah cara mengejanya.

b4b5e6750bc4.en: Habits: cracks her knuckles, rubs her shoulders and so on, from constant blacksmithing and hard work; a neutral, almost resting-bitch face, though she isn't that bitchy: she just keeps her distance from people she doesn't care for (anyone who isn't Darfaries).
b4b5e6750bc4.t: Tabiat: membunyikan buku jari, menggosok bahu dan sebagainya, kerana sentiasa bertukang besi dan bekerja keras; muka neutral, hampir seperti muka garang semula jadi, walaupun dia tidaklah segarang itu: dia cuma menjaga jarak dengan orang yang dia tidak peduli (sesiapa yang bukan Darfaries).

b59ddde6b5dc.en: Attracted to: young women with a good head on their shoulders, human and Wozefaries alike.
b59ddde6b5dc.t: Tertarik kepada: wanita muda yang berfikiran waras, manusia dan Wozefaries.

b5f182e2d49f.en: Itanema (1012 A.G. Asa 24th) came from a poor childhood, and with the help of her father, Sinoi, she became a maid at Sanbi's castle. Many visitors saw her cutting corners in her job, and even after being placed on a PIP to become as good as other maids, she still appears to be the usual Itanema. Maybe something about her tight-lipped, subservient nature keeps her from being replaced by better chefs and tailors constantly being trained at Forway's specialized school.
b5f182e2d49f.t: Itanema (24 Asa 1012 A.G.) datang dari zaman kanak-kanak yang miskin, dan dengan bantuan ayahnya, Sinoi, dia menjadi pembantu rumah di istana Sanbi. Ramai pelawat melihatnya mengambil jalan pintas dalam kerjanya, dan walaupun selepas diletakkan dalam PIP supaya menjadi sebaik pembantu rumah lain, dia masih nampak seperti Itanema yang biasa. Mungkin ada sesuatu tentang sifatnya yang berahsia dan patuh yang menghalangnya daripada diganti oleh cef dan tukang jahit yang lebih baik yang sentiasa dilatih di sekolah khusus Forway.

b5f78113646d.en: Likes and dislikes: loved jerky, and tiny girls. Loved tasting new dishes and drinks, and being at the center of a crowd, talking with people and building relationships.
b5f78113646d.t: Suka dan tidak suka: suka daging kering, dan gadis kecil molek. Suka merasa hidangan dan minuman baharu, dan berada di tengah-tengah orang ramai, berbual dengan orang dan membina hubungan.

b6609024e390.en: Likes and dislikes: hates blood, guts and anything dirty or messy. Loves reading and writing, and arguing and correcting people whenever he can. Loves sweets and baked goods. Hates Bagarisa nose with cheese.
b6609024e390.t: Suka dan tidak suka: benci darah, isi perut dan apa saja yang kotor atau bersepah. Suka membaca dan menulis, dan bertekak serta membetulkan orang bila-bila boleh. Suka manisan dan kuih-muih. Benci hidung Bagarisa dengan keju.

b6db67016f97.en: Flaws: argumentative: he loves pointing out the flaws in other people's facts, and can be a bit much; judgmental; moody; petulant; cowardly; thinks he's smarter than he is; sanctimonious at times, like thinking historians are better than adventurers.
b6db67016f97.t: Kelemahan: suka bertekak: dia suka menunjukkan kelemahan dalam fakta orang lain, dan boleh jadi sedikit melampau; suka menghakimi; moody; merajuk; penakut; fikir dia lebih bijak daripada sebenarnya; kadang-kadang berlagak suci, seperti fikir ahli sejarah lebih baik daripada pengembara.

b6f2b1bd5503.en: Strengths: adventurous; caring; charming; compassionate; genuine; romantic; warm; trusting; brave; selfless.
b6f2b1bd5503.t: Kekuatan: suka mengembara; penyayang; menawan; belas kasihan; tulen; romantik; mesra; mudah percaya; berani; tidak mementingkan diri.

b7769a8603a9.en: Speech: loud, direct and accusatory; bitchy. Don't ask about her past: she only lives in the present.
b7769a8603a9.t: Pertuturan: lantang, terus terang dan suka menuduh; perangai jalang. Jangan tanya tentang masa silamnya: dia hanya hidup untuk masa kini.

b78fa0fd2ac8.en: Attracted to: Wozefaries ladies, but cooking is his passion, so he never found a wife.
b78fa0fd2ac8.t: Tertarik kepada: wanita Wozefaries, tetapi memasak ialah minatnya, jadi dia tidak pernah berkahwin.

b81c44dcb7de.en: Speech: talks about himself, working himself into everything; a bit high-pitched.
b81c44dcb7de.t: Pertuturan: bercakap tentang diri sendiri, menyelitkan dirinya dalam segala hal; suara agak nyaring.

b8620db0137b.en: Vitor (1025 A.G. Asa 2nd) is ready to take Rebula from a random village not even on the map to a city where people would envy to live! He might pull that off one day on spirit alone, but being a homebody and introvert like her mother is not helping him with such an idealistic dream. At least he seems to have inherited both skills from his parents, so maybe it's just a matter of growing up first before tackling his dreams.
b8620db0137b.t: Vitor (2 Asa 1025 A.G.) bersedia untuk membawa Rebula daripada sebuah kampung rawak yang tiada pun dalam peta menjadi sebuah bandar yang dicemburui orang untuk didiami! Dia mungkin berjaya suatu hari nanti dengan semangat sahaja, tetapi sifatnya yang suka duduk di rumah dan introvert seperti ibunya tidak membantu impian yang begitu idealistik. Sekurang-kurangnya dia nampaknya mewarisi kemahiran kedua-dua ibu bapanya, jadi mungkin ia hanya soal membesar dahulu sebelum mengejar impiannya.

b9d5c5da69c2.en: Gabiro: an old bald man with a blue stripe on his head in a dark hooded robe, leaning on a cane, with a fish icon note.
b9d5c5da69c2.t: Gabiro: seorang lelaki tua botak dengan jalur biru di kepala dalam jubah bertudung gelap, bersandar pada tongkat, dengan nota ikon ikan.

ba10e5ab198b.en: Attracted to: kinder, taller men, but not necessarily Darfaries. Romantic by nature.
ba10e5ab198b.t: Tertarik kepada: lelaki yang lebih baik hati dan lebih tinggi, tetapi tidak semestinya Darfaries. Romantik secara semula jadi.

ba35aa1be6ae.en: Coema: two outfits of a blonde woman, a blue ruffled dress with yellow sleeves and a blue scale-patterned dress.
ba35aa1be6ae.t: Coema: dua pakaian seorang wanita berambut perang, gaun biru berkedut dengan lengan kuning dan gaun bercorak sisik biru.

ba5ba4956dc6.en: Speech: speaks softly, and doesn't pry much into others.
ba5ba4956dc6.t: Pertuturan: bercakap dengan lembut, dan tidak banyak mengorek hal orang lain.

ba8a9d889dcb.en: Backstory ("Isekai History (Prior to Story)"): up to 1039 A.G. Paulin 14th. For what happens after, see the book outline.
ba8a9d889dcb.t: Latar belakang (“Sejarah Isekai (Sebelum Cerita)”): sehingga 14 Paulin 1039 A.G. Untuk apa yang berlaku selepas itu, lihat rangka buku.

bbe789758693.en: Speech: jovial, with a lazy tone; careless; clicks his tongue, says "phew" and the like; a cackling laugh; curses.
bbe789758693.t: Pertuturan: riang, dengan nada malas; tidak peduli; mendecit lidah, berkata “fuh” dan seumpamanya; ketawa mengekek; mencarut.

bcc4d40ef9c3.en: Habits: usually flying around; loves sitting on people's shoulders, for a higher view of the world.
bcc4d40ef9c3.t: Tabiat: biasanya terbang ke sana sini; suka duduk di bahu orang, untuk pemandangan dunia yang lebih tinggi.

bdaced70346c.en: Flaws: flies off the handle when what he holds dear is disrespected; opinionated; slightly disobedient; adventurous; rambly.
bdaced70346c.t: Kelemahan: cepat naik angin apabila apa yang dia sayangi tidak dihormati; keras kepala dengan pendapat sendiri; sedikit ingkar; suka mengembara; bercakap meleret-leret.

beeb6508b64a.en: Born and raised in the Gandew Kingdom as the First Prince of Nooru and Satomi. He read books and asked his mother about the world, but she brushed him off, busy with her blacksmithing. So he went back to the books, and the more he read, the more he wanted to see things with his own eyes. People from other places told him stories that captivated him to no end, and he decided to go exploring; his mother tried to stop him, but it was too late. Like his father, he had an adventurous spirit, and people rarely recognized him as a First Prince. He made many wonderful memories exploring, and loved telling other adventurers about them in taverns.
beeb6508b64a.t: Lahir dan dibesarkan di Kerajaan Gandew sebagai Putera Pertama Nooru dan Satomi. Dia membaca buku dan bertanya ibunya tentang dunia, tetapi ibunya tidak mengendahkannya, sibuk dengan kerja tukang besinya. Jadi dia kembali kepada buku, dan semakin banyak dia membaca, semakin dia mahu melihat sendiri dengan matanya. Orang dari tempat lain menceritakan kisah yang memukau hatinya tanpa henti, dan dia memutuskan untuk pergi meneroka; ibunya cuba menghalang, tetapi sudah terlambat. Seperti ayahnya, dia ada jiwa pengembara, dan orang jarang mengenalinya sebagai Putera Pertama. Dia mencipta banyak kenangan indah semasa meneroka, dan suka menceritakannya kepada pengembara lain di kedai minum.

bf53877b565a.en: July: a girl with pink and teal hair in a red-and-white outfit with a cape and red boots, with her armor piece shown above.
bf53877b565a.t: July: seorang gadis berambut merah jambu dan hijau kebiruan dalam pakaian merah dan putih dengan jubah dan but merah, dengan kepingan perisainya ditunjukkan di atas.

c0140bb62c8f.en: Intelligence: not the most intelligent, or rather logical, so he trusts his gut a bit too much. That's why he believes eating Hifuna Yabuca can make him more powerful, even though he knows its effects.
c0140bb62c8f.t: Kecerdasan: bukan yang paling cerdas, atau lebih tepat, logik, jadi dia terlalu mempercayai gerak hatinya. Sebab itulah dia percaya makan Hifuna Yabuca boleh membuatnya lebih berkuasa, walaupun dia tahu kesannya.

c05815b04459.en: Likes and dislikes: loves sweets, playing with people's hair, and helping. Doesn't like being called out on something she should know but forgot, and can burst into tears if people keep prodding her.
c05815b04459.t: Suka dan tidak suka: suka manisan, bermain dengan rambut orang, dan membantu. Tidak suka ditegur tentang sesuatu yang patut dia tahu tetapi lupa, dan boleh menangis teresak-esak kalau orang terus mencucuknya.

c069e89aa725.en: Habits: finger-pointing; forceful; no chill; stiff; irascible; ready to punch someone's lights out.
c069e89aa725.t: Tabiat: menuding jari; kasar; tak boleh bertenang; kaku; panas baran; sedia menumbuk orang sampai pengsan.

c06fcb5be606.en: Likes and dislikes: loves relaxing, talking with people and socializing in general; loves prying into her daughter's affairs; loves helping people, especially if it bothers the people she hates. Doesn't like fatty foods.
c06fcb5be606.t: Suka dan tidak suka: suka bersantai, berbual dengan orang dan bersosial secara umum; suka mengorek hal ehwal anak perempuannya; suka membantu orang, terutamanya kalau ia menyusahkan orang yang dia benci. Tidak suka makanan berlemak.

c0a014b2f584.en: Strengths: principled; sporting; persistent; punctual; focused; reliable; frank.
c0a014b2f584.t: Kekuatan: berprinsip; sporting; gigih; menepati masa; fokus; boleh diharap; berterus terang.

c2b690534690.en: Posaqui (1023 A.G. Asa 33) is a natural Sanbi, and proud of it. He is known for his grandiose talking, sometimes going on for entire timehunks, especially when people gaslight him to do so. He is an Amethyst adventurer, constantly flashing highly decorated, sparkling weapons that look awfully unused for a supposed adventurer. Perhaps he needs it less because he often talks himself out of combat, or somehow his more diminutive stature allows him to be that extra swift with his weapons—or he illegally subcontracts the work. No one knows for sure, including Forway, after they investigated him for flashing too many new gadgets, makeup, and weapons despite being so picky about the quests he takes. The people that know him assume he dabbles in information trading, given how he's out about traveling non-stop.
c2b690534690.t: Posaqui (33 Asa 1023 A.G.) ialah anak jati Sanbi, dan bangga dengannya. Dia terkenal dengan cakapnya yang berjela-jela, kadang-kadang berterusan selama beberapa timehunk, terutamanya apabila orang memanipulasinya untuk berbuat begitu. Dia pengembara Amethyst, sentiasa menayangkan senjata berkilauan yang sangat berhias yang nampak terlalu jarang digunakan bagi seorang yang kononnya pengembara. Mungkin dia kurang memerlukannya kerana dia sering bercakap untuk mengelak pertarungan, atau entah bagaimana badannya yang lebih kecil membolehkannya menjadi lebih pantas dengan senjatanya—atau dia menyubkontrakkan kerja itu secara haram. Tiada siapa tahu dengan pasti, termasuk Forway, selepas mereka menyiasatnya kerana menayangkan terlalu banyak gajet, alat solek dan senjata baharu walaupun dia sangat memilih misi yang diambilnya. Orang yang mengenalinya mengandaikan dia berjinak-jinak dalam perdagangan maklumat, memandangkan dia sentiasa mengembara tanpa henti.

c2f395871aa7.en: Birthday: 1039 A.G. Paulin 14th (he counts it as his birthday, since he doesn't know his real one).
c2f395871aa7.t: Hari lahir: 14 Paulin 1039 A.G. (dia menganggapnya hari lahirnya, kerana dia tidak tahu tarikh sebenar).

c3b1a57d33ce.en: Melada (1007 A.G. Paulin 101th) describes herself as an entrepreneur, always ready to be the first to smell blood in the water of her enemies and strike head first with her knowledge of many industries and her many, many connections through the four kingdoms. Others succinctly describe her as a lying, thieving cunt. Her makeup is as heavy as her jewelry, and she has been in and out of so many guilds, contracts, investigations, and punishments that it placed measurable stress on Forway's bookkeeping on her. She is also known for gambling away a lot, which might be why she is no longer in Forway. She says that's a lie, and she still goes there all the time, but Toleridemians say otherwise, as they now have to put up with all the crap she's trying to pull, including her sister Honati and niece Dalila who has to come to the rescue every now and then.
c3b1a57d33ce.t: Melada (101 Paulin 1007 A.G.) menggambarkan dirinya sebagai usahawan, sentiasa bersedia menjadi yang pertama menghidu darah dalam air musuh-musuhnya dan menyerang terlebih dahulu dengan pengetahuannya tentang banyak industri dan rangkaian kenalannya yang sangat, sangat banyak di serata empat kerajaan. Orang lain menggambarkannya secara ringkas sebagai perempuan sial penipu dan pencuri. Soleknya setebal barang kemasnya, dan dia telah keluar masuk begitu banyak persatuan, kontrak, siasatan dan hukuman sehingga ia memberi tekanan yang ketara kepada simpan kira Forway tentang dirinya. Dia juga terkenal kerana banyak berjudi, yang mungkin sebab dia tidak lagi berada di Forway. Dia berkata itu bohong, dan dia masih ke sana sepanjang masa, tetapi orang Tolerideme berkata sebaliknya, kerana mereka kini terpaksa bersabar dengan segala karut yang cuba dilakukannya, termasuk adiknya Honati dan anak saudaranya Dalila yang terpaksa datang menyelamatkan sekali-sekala.

c4279a44fd02.en: Dalila (1027 A.G. Asa 17th) is, without a doubt, a distilled version of her mother’s intelligence combined with her father’s friendly demeanor and strong wanderlust. She picked up on Forway's distinct and ever-changing fashion trends more than her mom, but part of her heart is still Toleridemian. She probably has the same wanderlust problems as her father, if not worse, as she feels this tickle of venturing beyond the four kingdoms to see things nobody else has seen, maybe even finding the ancient species! She would skip Hifuna, though! She is not that crazy like some adventurers she heard from bards, read herself in the newspapers after they were torn apart like it was nothing, or glorified in the novels after they soul-died.
c4279a44fd02.t: Dalila (17 Asa 1027 A.G.) tidak syak lagi ialah pati kebijaksanaan ibunya digabungkan dengan perwatakan mesra ayahnya dan keinginan mengembara yang kuat. Dia lebih cepat menangkap trend fesyen Forway yang tersendiri dan sentiasa berubah berbanding ibunya, tetapi sebahagian hatinya masih orang Tolerideme. Dia mungkin mempunyai masalah keinginan mengembara yang sama seperti ayahnya, jika tidak lebih teruk, kerana dia merasa geli hati untuk meneroka melangkaui empat kerajaan untuk melihat perkara yang tidak pernah dilihat orang lain, malah mungkin menemui spesies purba! Tapi dia akan langkau Hifuna! Dia tidaklah segila sesetengah pengembara yang didengarnya daripada penyair kembara, dibacanya sendiri dalam akhbar selepas mereka dirobek-robek seolah-olah tiada apa-apa, atau diagung-agungkan dalam novel selepas mereka mengalami kematian jiwa.

c4bc73cf6a40.en: Intelligence: very smart and systematic in her nari gel experiments, but she needs a catalyst to push her mind and will forward, or she stalls and barely progresses. She can cook like no other and likes it, but Neferteri suppressed that, since a princess shouldn't be making food; having others cook for her became natural. So having Harry under her control, doing everything to please her (he did the cooking in the lab), was very enticing to her narcissistic brain. She needs an outlet for her creativity.
c4bc73cf6a40.t: Kecerdasan: sangat bijak dan sistematik dalam eksperimen nari gelnya, tetapi dia memerlukan pemangkin untuk mendorong minda dan kemahuannya ke depan, kalau tidak dia tersekat dan hampir tidak maju. Dia boleh memasak seperti tiada orang lain dan suka memasak, tetapi Neferteri menekannya, kerana puteri tidak sepatutnya membuat makanan; menyuruh orang lain memasak untuknya menjadi kebiasaan. Jadi memiliki Harry di bawah kawalannya, melakukan segalanya untuk menyenangkannya (dialah yang memasak di makmal), sangat menggoda bagi otak narsisistiknya. Dia memerlukan saluran untuk kreativitinya.

c547dab994fc.en: Flaws: distrustful, putting up a barrier with people she doesn't know; immature, especially emotionally; secretive; cold, for the same reasons; hangry, especially after a bad night's sleep.
c547dab994fc.t: Kelemahan: tidak mempercayai orang, membina tembok dengan orang yang tidak dikenalinya; tidak matang, terutamanya dari segi emosi; perahsia; dingin, atas sebab yang sama; lapar-marah, terutamanya selepas tidur malam yang teruk.

c5eceeb5468b.en: Flaws: blunt; finicky; sanctimonious; judgmental; vague; ignorant; boastful; apathetic about anything outside her immediate view; harsh.
c5eceeb5468b.t: Kelemahan: kasar terus terang; cerewet; berlagak suci; suka menghakimi; samar-samar; jahil; suka bermegah; tidak peduli apa saja di luar pandangannya; keras.

c61a4b46a05a.en: Flaws: pushy; pessimistic; picky; resentful (about not acting, though she never does); cold; coarse; passive; powerless; grumpy.
c61a4b46a05a.t: Kelemahan: suka mendesak; pesimis; cerewet; berdendam (kerana tidak bertindak, walaupun dia sendiri tidak pernah bertindak); dingin; kasar; pasif; tidak berdaya; pemarah.

c66504b6e4ae.en: Habits: slaps things; drinks a lot, and can get physical depending on how much she's had; has little sense of personal space and gets up close to people without giving a shit.
c66504b6e4ae.t: Tabiat: menampar benda; minum banyak, dan boleh bertindak kasar bergantung pada berapa banyak dia minum; kurang rasa ruang peribadi dan merapati orang tanpa peduli langsung.

c67fe00cefe5.en: Speech: says "Yes, Chef!" all the time. Doesn't ask questions; just does as he's told.
c67fe00cefe5.t: Pertuturan: asyik berkata “Baik, Cef!”. Tidak bertanya soalan; cuma buat apa yang disuruh.

c6ad7bfe8577.en: July (1013 A.G. Adrian 85th) fled Freeish, and finding her way into Forway, she became the youngest member accepted at Tea-Drinkers. Her CQC skills are bar none in the guild, but there's a good chance her charisma and making men feel good helped her get in. You can fully trust her as a party member, but please don't prod into her past or try to feed any nari gels to her—she literally killed someone for daring to splat nari refresher in her mouth. She is also very protective of her precious Mugi. It might be just an average-looking male Sayna, but its intelligence and cuddliness are certainly not average.
c6ad7bfe8577.t: July (85 Adrian 1013 A.G.) melarikan diri dari Freeish, dan setelah menemui jalan ke Forway, dia menjadi ahli termuda yang diterima di Tea-Drinkers. Kemahiran CQCnya tiada tandingan dalam persatuan itu, tetapi besar kemungkinan karismanya dan kebolehannya membuat lelaki rasa seronok membantunya diterima masuk. Anda boleh mempercayainya sepenuhnya sebagai ahli pasukan, tetapi tolong jangan korek masa lalunya atau cuba menyuapkan apa-apa nari gel kepadanya—dia benar-benar pernah membunuh seseorang kerana berani memercikkan nari refresher ke dalam mulutnya. Dia juga sangat melindungi Mugi kesayangannya. Ia mungkin sekadar Sayna jantan yang biasa rupanya, tetapi kecerdasan dan sifat manjanya pastinya bukan biasa.

c74066da9e29.en: Intelligence: taught herself to read. She's on the cunning side, but for lack of street smarts and knowledge of the world, especially of what being independent truly means, she ends up reserved, if not pessimistic, in how she thinks.
c74066da9e29.t: Kecerdasan: belajar membaca sendiri. Dia agak licik, tetapi kerana kurang bijak di jalanan dan kurang pengetahuan tentang dunia, terutamanya tentang apa maksud sebenar berdikari, dia akhirnya pendiam, kalau bukan pesimis, dalam cara dia berfikir.

c74d006111cf.en: Likes and dislikes: loves alcohol of any kind. Hates people who don't follow the plan.
c74d006111cf.t: Suka dan tidak suka: suka apa-apa jenis arak. Benci orang yang tidak ikut rancangan.

c7e274429128.en: Strengths: a bookworm, versed in the kingdom's history; disciplined; clever; subtle; articulate, a wordsmith; understanding; curious about the occult, especially the Finaies.
c7e274429128.t: Kekuatan: ulat buku, arif dalam sejarah kerajaan; berdisiplin; bijak; halus; petah, pandai bermain kata; memahami; ingin tahu tentang ilmu ghaib, terutamanya Finaies.

c8b747d60532.en: A true Forway boy, meaning he grew up on the streets. You'd expect him to be street-smart and quick-witted, but he's the opposite: he doesn't seem to have strong motivations, or he'll just do his own thing. Yosuke saw a chance to make him the restaurant's next chef by introducing him to lots of different food, but maybe he doesn't have the skills to be an innovator, just a doer.
c8b747d60532.t: Budak Forway sejati, maksudnya dia membesar di jalanan. Kau sangka dia bijak di jalanan dan cepat berfikir, tetapi dia sebaliknya: dia nampak tiada motivasi kuat, atau dia akan buat hal sendiri. Yosuke nampak peluang untuk menjadikannya cef restoran seterusnya dengan memperkenalkannya kepada pelbagai jenis makanan, tetapi mungkin dia tiada kemahiran untuk menjadi inovator, cuma pelaksana.

c8fbf78e40b2.en: Strengths: independent; loyal; clever; educated; skillful; cares about people, and believes that once someone is punished fairly, things are settled; knows what she wants and stays focused on her goals; secretive (which also has a bad side, since it makes her cold).
c8fbf78e40b2.t: Kekuatan: berdikari; setia; bijak; berpelajaran; mahir; mengambil berat tentang orang, dan percaya apabila seseorang dihukum secara adil, perkara itu selesai; tahu apa yang dia mahu dan kekal fokus pada matlamatnya; perahsia (yang juga ada sisi buruk, kerana ia membuatnya dingin).

c9ffb36aa71e.en: Speech: a neutral, somewhat cold tone in public; with her "bitch", very straightforward, almost lunatic. During experiments, lust pours through her veins, and her voice.
c9ffb36aa71e.t: Pertuturan: nada neutral dan agak dingin di khalayak ramai; dengan “anjing”nya, sangat terus terang, hampir gila. Semasa eksperimen, nafsu mengalir melalui uratnya, dan suaranya.

cb58b3e048c2.en: Born in Crossroads as Maicon Crossroads Black-Dove (he updated his badge to Forway Black-Dove as an adult), he grew up among the city's elite and their way of life, and now tries to raise his status and wealth by any means possible. He's infamous at the Red Winga as a "twink" kind of guy. They hate his guts, but every time he surfaces he has new information on someone, so he's quite useful.
cb58b3e048c2.t: Lahir di Crossroads sebagai Maicon Crossroads Black-Dove (dia mengemas kini lencananya kepada Forway Black-Dove sebagai dewasa), dia membesar dalam kalangan elit bandar itu dan cara hidup mereka, dan kini cuba meningkatkan status dan kekayaannya dengan apa cara sekalipun. Dia terkenal buruk di Red Winga sebagai lelaki jenis “twink”. Mereka benci dia sampai ke tulang, tetapi setiap kali dia muncul dia ada maklumat baharu tentang seseorang, jadi dia agak berguna.

cbbc4ef77787.en: Speech: deadpan, honest answers; neutral. He cuts off aggression with honesty, and ends up cutting off sarcasm and jokes with it too.
cbbc4ef77787.t: Pertuturan: jawapan bersahaja dan jujur; neutral. Dia mematahkan keagresifan dengan kejujuran, dan akhirnya turut mematahkan sindiran dan jenaka dengannya.

cc5da03ebcb0.en: Lifespan, Soul Energy capacity and so on: in the Soul Energy spreadsheet for characters.
cc5da03ebcb0.t: Jangka hayat, kapasiti Tenaga Jiwa dan sebagainya: dalam hamparan Tenaga Jiwa untuk watak.

cc6189f09832.en: Attracted to: defenseless, weak men she can whip into shape (her idea of shape).
cc6189f09832.t: Tertarik kepada: lelaki lemah tanpa pertahanan yang boleh dia bentuk (mengikut acuannya sendiri).

cdf848c3b54c.en: Flaws: mean; aggressive; intolerant; unkind; jealous; a hoarder; anxious.
cdf848c3b54c.t: Kelemahan: jahat; agresif; tidak bertoleransi; tidak baik hati; cemburu; suka menimbun barang; cemas.

ce1db508bab6.en: Publicly, people know he came out of one of the castle towers after the "silent" explosion, but nobody saw him being brought into the castle. He's the "missing piece" for understanding what Gabiro was up to. The official story is that his worth lies in being the Sanbi Eye, and Sanbi blamed Gabiro for the soul mess, but rumors persist.
ce1db508bab6.t: Secara umum, orang tahu dia keluar dari salah satu menara istana selepas letupan “senyap” itu, tetapi tiada siapa nampak dia dibawa masuk ke istana. Dialah “kepingan yang hilang” untuk memahami apa yang Gabiro sedang buat. Cerita rasminya ialah nilainya terletak pada menjadi Sanbi-eye, dan Sanbi menyalahkan Gabiro atas kekacauan jiwa itu, tetapi khabar angin masih berterusan.

ceb6db70f8c6.en: Flaws: bitchy; coarse; petulant; temperamental; stubborn; vengeful; condemnatory; can't let things go.
ceb6db70f8c6.t: Kelemahan: perangai jalang; kasar; merajuk; panas baran; degil; pendendam; suka menghukum; tidak boleh lepaskan sesuatu.

cf53aaa36322.en: Fascinated by: pretty, strong boys who are charming and highly confident.
cf53aaa36322.t: Terpesona dengan: budak lelaki yang kacak dan kuat, menawan dan sangat yakin diri.

cfdf56c937e9.en: Kiko (1018 A.G. Adrian 37th) is an entrepreneur known for founding the Half-cruro and bringing it from nothing into one of the biggest, at least in terms of raw size, guilds in the Sanbi kingdom. Some have accused his guild contracts of violating The Prosperity Treaty Section #4 Sub 1 & 3 for making the contract lopsided in benefitting the guild. However, Forway officials have stated that the fact it grants a pathway for Cruros to flee the tribes and become proper kingdom citizens is a fair exchange for lifelong servitude at cheap rates.
cfdf56c937e9.t: Kiko (37 Adrian 1018 A.G.) ialah usahawan yang terkenal kerana mengasaskan Half-cruro dan membawanya daripada tiada kepada salah satu persatuan terbesar, sekurang-kurangnya dari segi saiz mentah, di kerajaan Sanbi. Ada yang menuduh kontrak persatuannya melanggar Perjanjian Kemakmuran Seksyen #4 Subseksyen 1 & 3 kerana menjadikan kontrak itu berat sebelah menguntungkan persatuan. Namun, pegawai Forway menyatakan bahawa hakikat ia memberi laluan kepada Cruro untuk melarikan diri daripada puak dan menjadi warganegara kerajaan yang sah ialah pertukaran yang adil untuk perhambaan seumur hidup pada kadar murah.

d03383d21af7.en: Her parents came from Sundeath and ended up in a village nearby. She married a man from a local village too, Severino, and they had a son, Vitor. Life is simple, but good.
d03383d21af7.t: Ibu bapanya berasal dari Sundeath dan berakhir di sebuah kampung berdekatan. Dia juga berkahwin dengan lelaki dari kampung tempatan, Severino, dan mereka mendapat seorang anak lelaki, Vitor. Hidup ringkas, tetapi baik.

d073448290f6.en: Fernan: a dark-haired archer in red-and-silver armor, with his large thorned bow beside him.
d073448290f6.t: Fernan: pemanah berambut gelap dalam perisai merah dan perak, dengan busur besarnya yang berduri di sebelahnya.

d0f7c3cf1fa0.en: Habits: clean, and you can smell it from afar; judgmental, and shows what he's feeling; likes to stand up and walk around to think.
d0f7c3cf1fa0.t: Tabiat: bersih, dan kau boleh menghidunya dari jauh; suka menghakimi, dan menunjukkan apa yang dirasainya; suka berdiri dan berjalan-jalan untuk berfikir.

d12cc5b8cf74.en: A non-disclosure clause: she can't mention the contract to anyone outside the Red Winga.
d12cc5b8cf74.t: Klausa tidak mendedahkan: dia tidak boleh menyebut kontrak itu kepada sesiapa di luar Red Winga.

d14be583e3eb.en: Satomi: a woman with blue hair in a bun, wearing a light-blue apron and tall boots, resting a big hammer on her shoulders.
d14be583e3eb.t: Satomi: seorang wanita berambut biru bersanggul, memakai apron biru muda dan but tinggi, menyandarkan tukul besar di bahunya.

d234732fea5f.en: Attracted to: material things: hoarding whatever his mind desires. The Walking Heart stone corrupted his mind.
d234732fea5f.t: Tertarik kepada: benda material: menimbun apa saja yang diingini fikirannya. Batu Walking Heart merosakkan fikirannya.

d27739c0eb2d.en: Attracted to: Darfaries women, especially younger ones.
d27739c0eb2d.t: Tertarik kepada: wanita Darfaries, terutamanya yang lebih muda.

d32c5220beb5.en: Jonem (1029 A.G. Paulin 7th) is just as much of a bookworm as his mother and unsurprisingly looks like her too! Except he lacks the same wordsmith when it comes to talking with others—he digresses with that statement though. He's going to school, hoping to get a steady bookkeeping job rather than just being stuck at a library book reading. Safe to say, his mother came up with that phrase rather than him.
d32c5220beb5.t: Jonem (7 Paulin 1029 A.G.) sama ulat bukunya seperti ibunya dan, tidak menghairankan, rupanya juga seperti ibunya! Kecuali dia tidak sepetah ibunya apabila bercakap dengan orang lain—dia menyimpang dengan kenyataan itu. Dia bersekolah, berharap mendapat kerja penyimpan kira yang tetap dan bukannya sekadar terperuk di perpustakaan membaca buku. Boleh dikatakan ibunyalah yang mencipta ayat itu, bukan dia.

d3891ec6db4f.en: Attracted to: Darfaries men: strong, resolute and powerful.
d3891ec6db4f.t: Tertarik kepada: lelaki Darfaries: kuat, tegas dan berkuasa.

d4d3aba211ff.en: Ariana (1034 A.G. Adrian 34th) is the spitting image of her mother, Kianna, down to her boastful confidence and gullibility. There does seem to be a single difference, though—she is far more hotheaded, appearing at noble and related high-class parties, always entertaining the guests at the cost of her mother’s image. Who knows how many people are on her shit list, but they can be sure they will pay the price once she grows and becomes as famous as The Smart Ladies.
d4d3aba211ff.t: Ariana (34 Adrian 1034 A.G.) ialah salinan sebiji ibunya, Kianna, hingga kepada keyakinannya yang megah dan sifatnya yang mudah tertipu. Namun nampaknya ada satu perbezaan—dia jauh lebih panas baran, muncul di parti bangsawan dan parti kelas tinggi yang berkaitan, sentiasa menghiburkan tetamu dengan mengorbankan imej ibunya. Entah berapa ramai orang dalam senarai hitamnya, tetapi mereka boleh pasti mereka akan membayar harganya sebaik sahaja dia membesar dan menjadi seterkenal The Smart Ladies.

d4d899eb9d4b.en: On 1038 A.G. Paulin 98th (Sunnulow), after many adventures, he got way too drunk at The Dead Wozen bar and decided to ask a man about his awesome, voluptuous hair. He put a drunken hand on the man's shoulder, congratulated him and asked for tips. That "man" was Yacamim, who was pissed beyond belief when he blurted out that he'd thought she was a man, and immediately tried to punch him. He ducked with his amazing reflexes, which set off a massive bar brawl. Hiromi won fair and square, and as he went to pick her up, they fell in love with each other's awesomeness. He'll become the next King of Sanbi, since Yacamim will be queen, though neither of them wants it.
d4d899eb9d4b.t: Pada 98 Paulin 1038 A.G. (Sunnulow), selepas banyak pengembaraan, dia mabuk teruk di bar The Dead Wozen dan memutuskan untuk bertanya seorang lelaki tentang rambutnya yang hebat dan mengghairahkan. Dia meletakkan tangan mabuknya di bahu lelaki itu, mengucapkan tahniah dan meminta tip. “Lelaki” itu ialah Yacamim, yang marah tak terkata apabila dia terlepas cakap bahawa dia sangka Yacamim lelaki, dan terus cuba menumbuknya. Dia mengelak dengan refleksnya yang hebat, yang mencetuskan pergaduhan besar di bar. Hiromi menang secara adil, dan ketika dia pergi mengangkat Yacamim, mereka jatuh cinta dengan kehebatan masing-masing. Dia akan menjadi Raja Sanbi seterusnya, kerana Yacamim akan menjadi permaisuri, walaupun kedua-duanya tidak mahu.

d4f183de65a5.en: Interface: Darfaries, plus a Walking Heart stone.
d4f183de65a5.t: Antara muka: Darfaries, serta batu Walking Heart.

d5b938ce099c.en: From Big-Gyut. He grew up in a poor household and ended up in a life of crime, since that seemed like the only option. A friend of Clodoveu's.
d5b938ce099c.t: Dari Big-Gyut. Dia membesar dalam rumah tangga miskin dan berakhir dalam kehidupan jenayah, kerana itu nampak seperti satu-satunya pilihan. Kawan Clodoveu.

d79af7a44f9e.en: Speech: sometimes talks aloud, sometimes mumbles to himself. A husky voice that sounds like an ultimatum, though it likely isn't: good to listen to, like an old broadcaster. Loud and imperative, with clear enunciation; he likes to stand above others in a conversation and keep himself at its center. He doesn't talk much: direct and to the point, and he doesn't care for the minute details.
d79af7a44f9e.t: Pertuturan: kadang-kadang bercakap dengan kuat, kadang-kadang bergumam sendiri. Suara serak yang kedengaran seperti kata dua, walaupun mungkin bukan: sedap didengar, seperti penyiar lama. Lantang dan memerintah, dengan sebutan yang jelas; dia suka berada di atas orang lain dalam perbualan dan menjadikan dirinya pusat. Dia tidak banyak bercakap: terus terang dan ke pokok persoalan, dan dia tidak peduli butiran kecil.

d7f168f98efd.en: Born in Long-Bridge, Arukia had a peaceful but mundane and poor childhood. Wanting more of the world, and of herself, she ran away from her parents and ended up in Forway, like many girls do (see Vol 3, Chapter 4). She had some tough times in Forway before Emelia found her. Emelia saw how manipulative she was, and how much money she squeezed out of begging, so she brought her into the flower shop and gave her harder and harder tasks to test her as an agent. Arukia did so well that Emelia paid for her schooling in tailoring, cooking and accounting, so she could become an agent inside a rich household, if not a kingdom. Her willingness to do anything to get ahead, and her knack for hiding her secrets, paid off: she became one of the youngest agents of the Red Winga.
d7f168f98efd.t: Lahir di Long-Bridge, Arukia mengalami zaman kanak-kanak yang aman tetapi biasa dan miskin. Mahukan lebih daripada dunia, dan daripada dirinya, dia lari daripada ibu bapanya dan berakhir di Forway, seperti ramai gadis lain (lihat Jilid 3, Bab 4). Dia melalui masa sukar di Forway sebelum Emelia menemuinya. Emelia nampak betapa pandainya dia memanipulasi, dan betapa banyak wang yang dia perah daripada mengemis, jadi dia membawanya ke kedai bunga dan memberinya tugas yang semakin sukar untuk mengujinya sebagai ejen. Arukia melakukannya dengan begitu baik sehingga Emelia membiayai persekolahannya dalam jahitan, masakan dan perakaunan, supaya dia boleh menjadi ejen di dalam rumah tangga kaya, kalau bukan sebuah kerajaan. Kesanggupannya melakukan apa saja untuk maju, dan kebolehannya menyembunyikan rahsia, membuahkan hasil: dia menjadi antara ejen termuda Red Winga.

d80eae1663d6.en: Likes and dislikes: loves food, and above all its variety.
d80eae1663d6.t: Suka dan tidak suka: suka makanan, dan lebih daripada segalanya kepelbagaiannya.

d83022cf1424.en: Speech: clear and sincere, trying to be helpful with her judgment. She means no harm, but her tone can come across as harsh. With customers she puts on a facade: far more confident and resolute.
d83022cf1424.t: Pertuturan: jelas dan ikhlas, cuba membantu dengan penilaiannya. Dia tidak berniat jahat, tetapi nadanya boleh kedengaran keras. Dengan pelanggan dia memasang topeng: jauh lebih yakin dan tegas.

d84c7a0d2a99.en: Intelligence: keenly aware of the history of the Gandew Kingdom and its citizens. Nothing else matters to her.
d84c7a0d2a99.t: Kecerdasan: sangat arif tentang sejarah Kerajaan Gandew dan rakyatnya. Tiada perkara lain yang penting baginya.

d8e5089f1855.en: Attracted to: humans: charming, jovial and dependent, who care about her more than anyone else.
d8e5089f1855.t: Tertarik kepada: manusia: menawan, riang dan bergantung padanya, yang mengambil berat tentangnya lebih daripada orang lain.

da52efd04974.en: Jonem: a boy with short blue hair in a long gray-green cloak.
da52efd04974.t: Jonem: seorang budak lelaki berambut biru pendek dalam jubah panjang hijau kelabu.

dafe7d69cb5c.en: Flaws: somewhat wavering; gets stuck in some emotions, and takes a while to climb out of emotional pits; insecure; indecisive; facetious; gullible; disruptive, talking over people.
dafe7d69cb5c.t: Kelemahan: agak berbolak-balik; tersekat dalam sesetengah emosi, dan mengambil masa untuk keluar dari lubang emosi; tidak yakin diri; tidak tegas; suka berseloroh; mudah tertipu; suka mengganggu, memotong cakap orang.

dc2a03a832c2.en: Intelligence: as smart as her father, but with lower emotional intelligence: she's quicker to snap and use her fists instead of words.
dc2a03a832c2.t: Kecerdasan: sebijak ayahnya, tetapi dengan kecerdasan emosi yang lebih rendah: dia lebih cepat melenting dan menggunakan penumbuk dan bukannya kata-kata.

dc7fb0be698c.en: Huneo (1016 A.G. Adrian 13th) grew up in Forway, basked in its "higher mentality" cultural space where his family was filthy rich. That didn't make them forget about their roots, though, as they are still tied back to the Sanbi Kingdom and the rest of the "uncultured" family that still lives there. The family's "cultured" branch, especially Huneo, looks hellbent on making Sanbi Kingdom a proud place to live—removing that carefree, chill vibe. It's fair to say that's a tall order for a tiny man, but that's not stopping him as he has already become a Captain guard of the Sanbi Kingdom—although some believe some sapphire balls falling on someone's pockets had something to do with it.
dc7fb0be698c.t: Huneo (13 Adrian 1016 A.G.) membesar di Forway, berjemur dalam ruang budaya "berminda tinggi"nya di mana keluarganya kaya-raya. Namun itu tidak membuatkan mereka lupa asal-usul, kerana mereka masih terikat dengan Kerajaan Sanbi dan saudara-mara yang "tidak berbudaya" yang masih tinggal di sana. Cabang keluarga yang "berbudaya", terutamanya Huneo, nampak bertekad untuk menjadikan Kerajaan Sanbi tempat yang membanggakan untuk didiami—membuang suasana santai dan tidak peduli itu. Wajar dikatakan itu tugas yang berat bagi seorang lelaki yang kecil, tetapi itu tidak menghalangnya kerana dia sudah pun menjadi Kapten pengawal Kerajaan Sanbi—walaupun ada yang percaya beberapa bola sapphire yang jatuh ke dalam poket seseorang ada kaitan dengannya.

dd8ba486aa9e.en: Naunet (979 A.G. Adrian 25th) is the wife of the current Pharaoh of Sundeath—also her brother, but that's neither here nor there. Some refer to her as the Neferteri of the West. Still, you shouldn't say that to her face jokingly, even during her frequent visits to Gandew, or you might mysteriously be arrested the next time you visit Sundeath—which can be quite problematic if you don't have strings to pull given their "guilty until proven innocent" set in stone law. Her somewhat stoic face hides what she is brewing in her mind from even the best traders, parting enough people from their balls to continue funding the dessert hole called Sundeath.
dd8ba486aa9e.t: Naunet (25 Adrian 979 A.G.) ialah isteri Firaun Sundeath semasa—juga abangnya, tetapi itu bukan soalnya. Ada yang memanggilnya Neferteri dari Barat. Namun, anda tidak patut mengatakannya di depan mukanya walaupun bergurau, walaupun semasa lawatannya yang kerap ke Gandew, atau anda mungkin ditangkap secara misteri pada kali seterusnya anda melawat Sundeath—yang boleh menjadi agak bermasalah jika anda tiada orang dalam memandangkan undang-undang mereka yang termaktub "bersalah sehingga dibuktikan tidak bersalah". Wajahnya yang agak tenang menyembunyikan apa yang sedang difikirkannya daripada pedagang terbaik sekalipun, memisahkan cukup ramai orang daripada bola mereka untuk terus membiayai lubang pencuci mulut bernama Sundeath.

dde5d891999a.en: Morika (1014 A.G. Asa 24th) is like the antithesis of a Tolerideme gentleman! Not only he's ripped as fuck, but also unusually quiet and submissive. Whoever sees his badge will probably question if he needs to update his home location, but he refuses to tell anyone where he lives now or why he hasn't been around Tolerideme in a long while. Even Forway investigated him for tax evasion for taking so few quests from embassies, but they couldn't find any incriminating evidence—they also had a hard time finding him too, even after discovering he lived around SweetLake in his teen years.
dde5d891999a.t: Morika (24 Asa 1014 A.G.) ibarat antitesis seorang lelaki budiman Tolerideme! Bukan sahaja dia sasa gila, malah luar biasa pendiam dan patuh. Sesiapa yang melihat lencananya mungkin tertanya-tanya sama ada dia perlu mengemas kini lokasi rumahnya, tetapi dia enggan memberitahu sesiapa di mana dia tinggal sekarang atau kenapa sudah lama dia tidak berada di sekitar Tolerideme. Malah Forway menyiasatnya kerana mengelak cukai kerana mengambil terlalu sedikit misi dari kedutaan, tetapi mereka tidak menemui sebarang bukti yang memberatkan—mereka juga sukar menjejakinya, walaupun selepas mendapati dia tinggal di sekitar SweetLake semasa remaja.

de68816b271e.en: Lofinghy: a man in a military cap and white-and-black armor, shown with a crossbow, a gauntlet and a bottle.
de68816b271e.t: Lofinghy: seorang lelaki bertopi tentera dan berperisai putih dan hitam, ditunjukkan dengan busur silang, sarung tangan perisai dan sebotol minuman.

de727ab113f4.en: He died on an expedition, killed by his Black Sapphire colleagues on Fuhrair: he had found a torture prison where a handful of Fuhraies had been kept for what felt like an eternity, while a group of Black Sapphires tried to figure out how to prolong life. Fernan couldn't accept what they were doing to them, so they killed him and stashed his body. Officially, he died on a dangerous mission in Hifuna: someone of similar build wore his armor and carried his weapon to Tastyleaf to hide the trail, which made searching for him far more dangerous. His wife lives in Blood City with Magi's little brother, Jonem.
de727ab113f4.t: Dia mati dalam satu ekspedisi, dibunuh oleh rakan sekerja Black Sapphire di Fuhrair: dia telah menemui penjara penyeksaan tempat segelintir Fuhraies dikurung untuk tempoh yang terasa seperti selama-lamanya, sementara sekumpulan Black Sapphire cuba mencari cara memanjangkan umur. Fernan tidak dapat menerima apa yang mereka lakukan kepada mereka, jadi mereka membunuhnya dan menyorokkan mayatnya. Secara rasmi, dia mati dalam misi berbahaya di Hifuna: seseorang yang bertubuh serupa memakai perisainya dan membawa senjatanya ke Tastyleaf untuk menyembunyikan jejak, yang menjadikan usaha mencarinya jauh lebih berbahaya. Isterinya tinggal di Blood City bersama adik lelaki Magi, Jonem.

dea9a8e9d5b3.en: Intelligence: street smarts. He can't read, but knows how to pull information out of people.
dea9a8e9d5b3.t: Kecerdasan: bijak di jalanan. Dia tidak boleh membaca, tetapi tahu cara mengorek maklumat daripada orang.

dee52334c0fe.en: Attracted to: a decisive woman around his age, as tall as him or taller, but not a Darfaries.
dee52334c0fe.t: Tertarik kepada: wanita yang tegas sebaya dengannya, setinggi atau lebih tinggi daripadanya, tetapi bukan Darfaries.

df2463fa845b.en: Habits: aggressive and quick to snap; his fists often clench, ready to kill anyone who steps out of line; hits things; commanding; likes to stand higher than everyone else.
df2463fa845b.t: Tabiat: agresif dan cepat melenting; penumbuknya selalu tergenggam, sedia membunuh sesiapa yang melampaui batas; memukul benda; suka memerintah; suka berdiri lebih tinggi daripada semua orang.

df28ed996167.en: Likes and dislikes: dislikes vagueness and room for interpretation. Loves a sense of order, and a queue of things to do.
df28ed996167.t: Suka dan tidak suka: tidak suka kekaburan dan ruang untuk tafsiran. Suka rasa keteraturan, dan barisan benda untuk dibuat.

dfbd85b89415.en: Intelligence: very smart at negotiating and at looking out for himself; some street smarts.
dfbd85b89415.t: Kecerdasan: sangat bijak berunding dan menjaga kepentingan diri; sedikit bijak di jalanan.

e125e9e1feb1.en: Strengths: trusting; not pushy; loving and family-centered; agreeable; friendly; positive.
e125e9e1feb1.t: Kekuatan: mudah percaya; tidak mendesak; penyayang dan mementingkan keluarga; mudah bersetuju; mesra; positif.

e12b25f1ea90.en: Born in Gandew, the second children of Satomi and Nooru along with her twin, Katsumi, but thrown off the cliff and rescued in the desert by the Red Winga. Under the Red Winga's "protection", she grew up in Forway doing odd jobs for the madams, until she came of age and was persuaded to sign a contract to become an agent (mostly because of her sister). A few weeks later, the two of them fled, but they were caught and punished for it. She resents that Flatland never rescued them instead, but she never does anything to change her situation; in fact, she piles on so much pessimism that her sister loses heart about it.
e12b25f1ea90.t: Lahir di Gandew, anak kedua Satomi dan Nooru bersama kembarnya, Katsumi, tetapi dibuang dari tebing dan diselamatkan di padang pasir oleh Red Winga. Di bawah “perlindungan” Red Winga, dia membesar di Forway membuat kerja-kerja kecil untuk para madam, sehingga dia cukup umur dan dipujuk menandatangani kontrak untuk menjadi ejen (kebanyakannya kerana kakaknya). Beberapa minggu kemudian, kedua-duanya melarikan diri, tetapi mereka ditangkap dan dihukum kerananya. Dia berdendam kerana Flatland tidak pernah menyelamatkan mereka, tetapi dia tidak pernah berbuat apa-apa untuk mengubah keadaannya; malah, dia menimbunkan begitu banyak pesimisme sehingga kakaknya hilang semangat.

e165449cfe18.en: Likes and dislikes: loves Gandew and its people. Hates her husband's "dark side", but doesn't want to disturb the status quo, so she keeps it hidden. Loves strong beer; hates milk.
e165449cfe18.t: Suka dan tidak suka: sayang Gandew dan rakyatnya. Benci “sisi gelap” suaminya, tetapi tidak mahu mengganggu keadaan sedia ada, jadi dia merahsiakannya. Suka bir keras; benci susu.

e316029b548a.en: Namia: front views and profile close-ups of a dark-haired woman in gray leather armor with a long black cape.
e316029b548a.t: Namia: pandangan depan dan gambar dekat profil seorang wanita berambut gelap dalam perisai kulit kelabu dengan jubah hitam panjang.

e35469dd6639.en: Nina: a small girl with lavender hair in a pink robe with blue sleeves.
e35469dd6639.t: Nina: seorang gadis kecil berambut ungu muda dalam jubah merah jambu dengan lengan biru.

e3baa36a885c.en: Akemi (993 A.G. Asa 64th) is your usual bookworm, living more within the words than actual life. One would expect she would always be a librarian, and she was. She also tried the adventurer gig to find the plethora of relics portrayed extensively in the books she mentally tasted, and she did! His name was Fernan, and it was as if the pages of her novels had fused to create a perfect being. Now there's no reason to go outdoors anymore because insects are as terrifying as mold.
e3baa36a885c.t: Akemi (64 Asa 993 A.G.) ialah ulat buku yang biasa, lebih banyak hidup dalam kata-kata berbanding kehidupan sebenar. Orang akan menyangka dia akan sentiasa menjadi pustakawan, dan memang begitu. Dia juga mencuba kerja pengembara untuk mencari pelbagai relik yang digambarkan dengan meluas dalam buku-buku yang dinikmatinya dalam fikiran, dan dia berjaya! Namanya Fernan, dan seolah-olah halaman novel-novelnya bercantum untuk mencipta makhluk yang sempurna. Kini tiada sebab lagi untuk keluar rumah kerana serangga sama menakutkan seperti kulat.

e401cb3e96e7.en: Namia (1015 A.G. Paulin 27) came from one of the servant pharaoh families in Sundeath but, at some point, moved to Sanbi. Not much is known about her given how few friends she seems to have, but the little some know points to her being a nari gel abuser, spending all her money trying out different fake bodies, especially animals and beasts, for who knows what. She is not an adventurer and won't talk about herself. Some have mistaken her for Queen Neferteri, but likely that is down to Sanbi & Tolerideme people unable to tell people from Sundeath apart from one another, like cruros, or she could be using nari gels too. Either way, don't get in her way, or she will cut you down.
e401cb3e96e7.t: Namia (27 Paulin 1015 A.G.) berasal daripada salah satu keluarga firaun hamba di Sundeath tetapi, pada satu ketika, berpindah ke Sanbi. Tidak banyak yang diketahui tentangnya memandangkan betapa sedikit kawan yang dimilikinya, tetapi yang sedikit diketahui sesetengah orang menunjukkan dia penyalah guna nari gel, menghabiskan semua wangnya mencuba tubuh palsu yang berbeza, terutamanya haiwan dan makhluk buas, untuk entah apa tujuannya. Dia bukan pengembara dan tidak mahu bercakap tentang dirinya. Ada yang tersalah sangka dia sebagai Permaisuri Neferteri, tetapi kemungkinan besar itu kerana orang Sanbi & Tolerideme tidak dapat membezakan orang Sundeath antara satu sama lain, seperti cruro, atau dia mungkin menggunakan nari gel juga. Apa-apa pun, jangan halang jalannya, atau dia akan menetak anda.

e42812412bb1.en: Brandi: a large woman in a green gown with a tall veiled hat, holding a hooded baby.
e42812412bb1.t: Brandi: seorang wanita besar dalam gaun hijau dengan topi tinggi bertudung jaring, mendukung bayi bertudung.

e48fdff799d1.en: Flaws: fanatical; blunt; truculent, especially about cooking; an overworker; expects others to dance to his rhythm, especially in his kitchen.
e48fdff799d1.t: Kelemahan: fanatik; kasar terus terang; suka bergaduh, terutamanya tentang memasak; gila kerja; mengharapkan orang lain menari mengikut rentaknya, terutamanya di dapurnya.

e49b562a283b.en: Strengths: helpful, like his father; idealistic; curious; clean; hardworking; shy; loving.
e49b562a283b.t: Kekuatan: suka membantu, seperti ayahnya; idealistik; ingin tahu; bersih; rajin; pemalu; penyayang.

e49d09421adb.en: Severino (1007 A.G. Adrian 79th) is well-known around the countryside south of Forway for his expertise in logging and forest management—even though he doesn't have a formal education. As the village elder of Rebula, he is a stern leader of his populace. One would expect most to bitch about him and his authoritarian leadership, but his passion for his village's prosperity inspires everyone to do their best—plus, nobody wants to be on his shit list.
e49d09421adb.t: Severino (79 Adrian 1007 A.G.) terkenal di kawasan pedalaman selatan Forway kerana kepakarannya dalam pembalakan dan pengurusan hutan—walaupun dia tiada pendidikan formal. Sebagai ketua kampung Rebula, dia pemimpin yang tegas terhadap penduduknya. Orang akan menyangka kebanyakan penduduk merungut tentangnya dan kepimpinannya yang autoritarian, tetapi semangatnya untuk kemakmuran kampungnya mengilhamkan semua orang untuk melakukan yang terbaik—tambahan pula, tiada siapa mahu masuk senarai hitamnya.

e4b1140a7281.en: Likes and dislikes: loves seeing people grow under her wing, and seeing her morals take root in them, and the loyalty that comes from it. Hates laziness and unwillingness.
e4b1140a7281.t: Suka dan tidak suka: suka melihat orang berkembang di bawah sayapnya, dan melihat moralnya berakar dalam diri mereka, serta kesetiaan yang lahir daripadanya. Benci kemalasan dan keengganan.

e4b37cec9a29.en: Flaws: abrasive; arrogant; boastful; self-indulgent; temperamental; not detail-oriented; truculent.
e4b37cec9a29.t: Kelemahan: kasar; angkuh; suka bermegah; memanjakan diri; panas baran; tidak teliti; suka bergaduh.

e5d461104cf8.en: Binaata is his full name; Biny is a nickname.
